_about: Round-4 validation set (2026-06-04), simple -> complicated, on a server with ALL fixes live (5 extraction guards + ghost-cleanup + dedup discriminator). Added in array order; supersession + dedup setups depend on order (s1 before s3; c3 before c4). gold = evaluator expectation; graders judge against content + taxonomy.

memories.content: PostgreSQL is our primary relational database.
memories.probe: SIMPLE baseline + dedup-merge SETUP: s3 ('Postgres') must merge onto this one entity.

memories.content: I prefer pnpm over npm for installing dependencies.
memories.probe: SIMPLE selection: 'prefer X over Y' -> IMPROVES_ON, NOT REPLACES (no false supersession).

memories.content: Postgres stores the audit log for compliance.
memories.probe: DEDUP-ALLOW (live): 'Postgres' must MERGE onto s1's 'postgres' (no discriminator) -> ONE postgres entity carrying both memory_ids. Confirms the discriminator gate still permits legit merges.

memories.content: We shipped v2.0 of the analytics dashboard on 2026-03-15.
memories.probe: SIMPLE milestone: version literal 'v2.0' is NOT an entity; HAPPENED_ON to the date; date must be the literal 2026-03-15 (value-fidelity).

memories.content: The web app, the mobile client, and the partner integration all authenticate through Keycloak.
memories.probe: COORDINATED-SUBJECT FAN-OUT: three subjects -> three USES edges to keycloak.

memories.content: The ingestion worker no longer writes to Kafka directly; it now depends on the schema registry and fails to start if the registry is down.
memories.probe: NEGATION ('no longer writes to Kafka' -> NO ingestion->kafka USES/DEPENDS_ON) + hard dep ('fails to start if down' -> DEPENDS_ON schema registry, not USES).
SUPERSESSION TARGET: must be active until c4; c4's migration should flip it to superseded.

memories.content: Last month we migrated the product search from Elasticsearch to OpenSearch to escape the license change.
memories.probe: REAL migration ('migrated from X to Y') -> opensearch REPLACES elasticsearch; should SUPERSEDE c3 (same project, elasticsearch in technologies, c3 older+active).

memories.content: The January incident was traced to a memory leak in the cache layer.
memories.probe: DEDUP DISCRIMINATOR A: 'january incident' entity (cosine ~0.885 to 'february incident').

memories.content: The February incident was traced to a disk-full error on the primary database node.
memories.probe: DEDUP DISCRIMINATOR B (live, the headline new-fix check): 'february incident' must NOT merge onto c5a's 'january incident' despite ~0.885 cosine. Both must exist as distinct entities.
